</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:ride-opd" data-paper-title="The Teacher Is a Direction, Not a Destination: Extrapolating RL-Induced Representation Residuals in On-Policy Distillation" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="mechanism" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/student-trajectory-distillation" data-search="The Teacher Is a Direction, Not a Destination: Extrapolating RL-Induced Representation Residuals in On-Policy Distillation LLM 后训练 原文未列机构 2026-09-29 RIDE 不在输出概率空间放大 teacher/student ratio，而是在每层每个 token 计算 RL teacher 相对其 pre-RL checkpoint 的 hidden residual：；学生回归到，其中把方向延伸到 teacher 之外。teacher/base 均 stop-gradient，避免目标分支被学生更新。 复现级别：L1 表征目标。复现级别：L1 表征目标。实现 base→RL teacher 的逐层残差外推与 masked regression。ride_target 与 ride_loss 覆盖退化、外推、mask 和 teacher stop-gradient；三种子机制结果见 metrics/mechanism-seeds42-44.json。未加载四组真实 base/RL teacher checkpoint，不能视为论文效果复现。  On-policy distillation 表征蒸馏 LLM 后训练 在策略蒸馏：沿学生实际走过的前缀学习 RIDE把教师超过基座的hidden residual继续外推，为什么不是放大输出概率比？ 残差定义在逐层逐token表示中，是RL教师相对其pre-RL基座的变化方向；学生回归到基座加放大残差的目标。输出概率比没有保存这条内部表示路径，不能互换。教师和基座停止梯度，外推系数超过一也不保证超过教师能力，仍需独立任务验证。 教学例子：先比较同一模型RL前后某层表示的位移，再沿该方向延长；这与把教师更喜欢的输出词统一加大权重不是一回事。 2026-10-27">
<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/student-trajectory-distillation/">LLM 后训练 / 在策略蒸馏：沿学生实际走过的前缀学习</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-level">核心机制</p>
<h2 id="qa-9eaccf1ab5755fc3">RIDE把教师超过基座的hidden residual继续外推，为什么不是放大输出概率比？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Aride-opd">The Teacher Is a Direction, Not a Destination: Extrapolating RL-Induced Representation Residuals in On-Policy Distillation</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · 原文未列机构</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>残差定义在逐层逐token表示中，是RL教师相对其pre-RL基座的变化方向；学生回归到基座加放大残差的目标。输出概率比没有保存这条内部表示路径，不能互换。教师和基座停止梯度，外推系数超过一也不保证超过教师能力，仍需独立任务验证。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>先比较同一模型RL前后某层表示的位移，再沿该方向延长；这与把教师更喜欢的输出词统一加大权重不是一回事。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动；例子用于解释机制。</p>

</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:ride-opd" data-paper-title="The Teacher Is a Direction, Not a Destination: Extrapolating RL-Induced Representation Residuals in On-Policy Distillation" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="implementation" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/student-trajectory-distillation" data-search="The Teacher Is a Direction, Not a Destination: Extrapolating RL-Induced Representation Residuals in On-Policy Distillation LLM 后训练 原文未列机构 2026-09-29 RIDE 不在输出概率空间放大 teacher/student ratio，而是在每层每个 token 计算 RL teacher 相对其 pre-RL checkpoint 的 hidden residual：；学生回归到，其中把方向延伸到 teacher 之外。teacher/base 均 stop-gradient，避免目标分支被学生更新。 复现级别：L1 表征目标。复现级别：L1 表征目标。实现 base→RL teacher 的逐层残差外推与 masked regression。ride_target 与 ride_loss 覆盖退化、外推、mask 和 teacher stop-gradient；三种子机制结果见 metrics/mechanism-seeds42-44.json。未加载四组真实 base/RL teacher checkpoint，不能视为论文效果复现。  On-policy distillation 表征蒸馏 LLM 后训练 在策略蒸馏：沿学生实际走过的前缀学习 RIDE的teacher与base分支为什么都stop-gradient？ 目标应代表固定的RL变化，学生只回归这个目标；若两分支跟着更新，会让残差自身移动。层、token和表示维度还需对齐，不能任意跨层相减。 例如学生误差通过教师分支反传会改变靶子，而非只改善学生。 2026-10-27">
<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/student-trajectory-distillation/">LLM 后训练 / 在策略蒸馏：沿学生实际走过的前缀学习</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-level">实现细节</p>
<h2 id="qa-c27131a205381263">RIDE的teacher与base分支为什么都stop-gradient？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Aride-opd">The Teacher Is a Direction, Not a Destination: Extrapolating RL-Induced Representation Residuals in On-Policy Distillation</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · 原文未列机构</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>目标应代表固定的RL变化，学生只回归这个目标；若两分支跟着更新，会让残差自身移动。层、token和表示维度还需对齐，不能任意跨层相减。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如学生误差通过教师分支反传会改变靶子，而非只改善学生。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动；例子用于解释机制。</p>

</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:ride-opd" data-paper-title="The Teacher Is a Direction, Not a Destination: Extrapolating RL-Induced Representation Residuals in On-Policy Distillation" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="comparison" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/student-trajectory-distillation" data-search="The Teacher Is a Direction, Not a Destination: Extrapolating RL-Induced Representation Residuals in On-Policy Distillation LLM 后训练 原文未列机构 2026-09-29 RIDE 不在输出概率空间放大 teacher/student ratio，而是在每层每个 token 计算 RL teacher 相对其 pre-RL checkpoint 的 hidden residual：；学生回归到，其中把方向延伸到 teacher 之外。teacher/base 均 stop-gradient，避免目标分支被学生更新。 复现级别：L1 表征目标。复现级别：L1 表征目标。实现 base→RL teacher 的逐层残差外推与 masked regression。ride_target 与 ride_loss 覆盖退化、外推、mask 和 teacher stop-gradient；三种子机制结果见 metrics/mechanism-seeds42-44.json。未加载四组真实 base/RL teacher checkpoint，不能视为论文效果复现。  On-policy distillation 表征蒸馏 LLM 后训练 在策略蒸馏：沿学生实际走过的前缀学习 α大于一的表征外推能保证比教师更强吗？ 不能，线性方向超出教师点可能扩大有益变化，也可能离开可靠区域。它是构造目标的假设，需独立任务检验，不能仅因几何上更远就称能力递增。 例如同一方向走过头可能破坏信息，超越坐标不等于超越表现。 2026-10-27">
<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/student-trajectory-distillation/">LLM 后训练 / 在策略蒸馏：沿学生实际走过的前缀学习</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-level">方法对比</p>
<h2 id="qa-0302ec7605024b73">α大于一的表征外推能保证比教师更强吗？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Aride-opd">The Teacher Is a Direction, Not a Destination: Extrapolating RL-Induced Representation Residuals in On-Policy Distillation</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · 原文未列机构</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>不能，线性方向超出教师点可能扩大有益变化，也可能离开可靠区域。它是构造目标的假设，需独立任务检验，不能仅因几何上更远就称能力递增。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如同一方向走过头可能破坏信息，超越坐标不等于超越表现。</p>

<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/student-trajectory-distillation/">LLM 后训练 / 在策略蒸馏：沿学生实际走过的前缀学习</a></p>
<span id="paper-post-training-ride-opd-b6296fc3" class="ar-learning-paper-anchor"></span>
<p class="ar-learning-level">基础理解</p>
<h2 id="qa-7230b8ff5992213f">RIDE外推的是输出概率还是隐藏表征残差？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Aride-opd">The Teacher Is a Direction, Not a Destination: Extrapolating RL-Induced Representation Residuals in On-Policy Distillation</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · 原文未列机构</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>每层每token比较RL教师与其pre-RL基座的隐藏差，再把基座加放大残差作为学生回归目标。它借的是RL表征变化方向，不是扩大logits比率。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如在某层把学到的方向再延长，而不是把教师最喜欢词概率乘常数。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动；例子用于解释机制。</p>

</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:rfpo" data-paper-title="Unlocking the Critic: Reward-Free Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="mechanism" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/policy-optimization" data-search="Unlocking the Critic: Reward-Free Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training LLM 后训练 University of Luxembourg 2026-09-29 冻结已校准 critic，把前缀成功概率同时作为 rollout reward、GAE baseline 和未完成轨迹预报，并在去长度偏置后二值化，降低策略利用 critic 偏差的风险。 复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。执行冻结 critic 的去偏、二值奖励与 GAE；未训练长链思维模型。执行冻结 critic 的去偏、二值奖励与 GAE；未训练长链思维模型。三种子诊断见 metrics/mechanism-seeds42-44.json。其中 diagnostic_only=true，不能进入正式能力排名。  RL 冻结 Critic 无标签奖励 LLM 后训练 策略优化：谁在采样，谁在被更新 RFPO冻结critic后，为什么还需要去长度偏置和二值化，不能直接最大化它的连续分数？ 冻结只阻止critic参数继续变化，不能消除其评分偏差。策略仍可能通过冗长或其他捷径提高分数，因此方法对前缀成功估计去偏并二值化，同时把critic用于基线和未完成轨迹预报。reward-free不等于无监督来源，而是复用已校准critic提供信号。 教学例子：critic偏爱长推理，学生即使不更正确也可靠加长拿高分；固定critic之后，这个可利用的偏差仍然存在。 2026-10-27">
<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/policy-optimization/">LLM 后训练 / 策略优化：谁在采样，谁在被更新</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-level">核心机制</p>
<h2 id="qa-cfcc645e9e1f5910">RFPO冻结critic后，为什么还需要去长度偏置和二值化，不能直接最大化它的连续分数？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Arfpo">Unlocking the Critic: Reward-Free Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · University of Luxembourg</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>冻结只阻止critic参数继续变化，不能消除其评分偏差。策略仍可能通过冗长或其他捷径提高分数，因此方法对前缀成功估计去偏并二值化，同时把critic用于基线和未完成轨迹预报。reward-free不等于无监督来源，而是复用已校准critic提供信号。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>critic偏爱长推理，学生即使不更正确也可靠加长拿高分；固定critic之后，这个可利用的偏差仍然存在。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37119">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.37119-rfpo/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-cfcc645e9e1f5910">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>

<h2 id="qa-ee0051c78752baa7">RFPO为什么冻结critic，并区分未完成轨迹的预报？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Arfpo">Unlocking the Critic: Reward-Free Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training</a></p>

<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>冻结保证策略训练期间评价基准明确，未完成预报用于处理尚无终局结果的轨迹，不能冒充已验证成功。当前本地只执行去偏、二值奖励和GAE核，未训练长推理模型。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如截断轨迹的高成功预报要保留估计身份，不能直接标成真实答案正确。</p>

<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:rfpo" data-paper-title="Unlocking the Critic: Reward-Free Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="comparison" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/policy-optimization" data-search="Unlocking the Critic: Reward-Free Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training LLM 后训练 University of Luxembourg 2026-09-29 冻结已校准 critic，把前缀成功概率同时作为 rollout reward、GAE baseline 和未完成轨迹预报，并在去长度偏置后二值化，降低策略利用 critic 偏差的风险。 复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。执行冻结 critic 的去偏、二值奖励与 GAE；未训练长链思维模型。执行冻结 critic 的去偏、二值奖励与 GAE；未训练长链思维模型。三种子诊断见 metrics/mechanism-seeds42-44.json。其中 diagnostic_only=true，不能进入正式能力排名。  RL 冻结 Critic 无标签奖励 LLM 后训练 策略优化：谁在采样，谁在被更新 critic同时作奖励与baseline会带来什么额外风险？ 两种角色共享偏差时，策略可能利用critic盲点。去长度偏置和二值化用于限制这种利用，但不能保证评价器不受攻击，也不能用critic自身得分证明真实能力提升。 例如把冗长文字误判成更可能成功，策略就可能只学会拖长输出。 2026-10-27">

<h2 id="qa-17d352b39cff66da">critic同时作奖励与baseline会带来什么额外风险？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Arfpo">Unlocking the Critic: Reward-Free Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · University of Luxembourg</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>两种角色共享偏差时，策略可能利用critic盲点。去长度偏置和二值化用于限制这种利用，但不能保证评价器不受攻击，也不能用critic自身得分证明真实能力提升。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如把冗长文字误判成更可能成功，策略就可能只学会拖长输出。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>

</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:rfpo" data-paper-title="Unlocking the Critic: Reward-Free Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="basics" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/policy-optimization" data-search="Unlocking the Critic: Reward-Free Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training LLM 后训练 University of Luxembourg 2026-09-29 冻结已校准 critic，把前缀成功概率同时作为 rollout reward、GAE baseline 和未完成轨迹预报，并在去长度偏置后二值化，降低策略利用 critic 偏差的风险。 复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。执行冻结 critic 的去偏、二值奖励与 GAE；未训练长链思维模型。执行冻结 critic 的去偏、二值奖励与 GAE；未训练长链思维模型。三种子诊断见 metrics/mechanism-seeds42-44.json。其中 diagnostic_only=true，不能进入正式能力排名。  RL 冻结 Critic 无标签奖励 LLM 后训练 策略优化：谁在采样，谁在被更新 RFPO的reward-free是不是不需要任何质量信号？ 它用已校准且冻结的critic预测前缀成功概率，替代训练时昂贵的外部终局奖励。监督被转移到critic而非消失，critic可靠性仍决定信号质量。 例如未完成解答可获得成功预估，但这来自已有评价能力，不是凭空知道答案。 2026-10-27">

<h2 id="qa-679b738a1f593837">RFPO的reward-free是不是不需要任何质量信号？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Arfpo">Unlocking the Critic: Reward-Free Policy Optimization for LLM Post-Training</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · University of Luxembourg</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>它用已校准且冻结的critic预测前缀成功概率，替代训练时昂贵的外部终局奖励。监督被转移到critic而非消失，critic可靠性仍决定信号质量。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如未完成解答可获得成功预估，但这来自已有评价能力，不是凭空知道答案。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37119">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.37119-rfpo/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-679b738a1f593837">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:pr-opd" data-paper-title="PR-OPD: Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="mechanism" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/teacher-and-context" data-search="PR-OPD: Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning LLM 后训练 University of Florida 2026-09-29 GRPO warm start 后，策略为每条已完成轨迹写一条 hindsight skill，并对同一 response 做普通 context 与 skill context 两次 forward。后者是 stop-gradient teacher；PR-OPD 在每层、每个 response token 对齐投影 hidden state，再与 reward objective 组合。推理时 skill 和 teacher 分支都移除。 复现级别：L1 表征对齐目标。复现级别：L1 表征对齐目标。实现多层、多 response-token 的 stop-gradient privileged alignment。测试覆盖相同表征时零损失、不同表征时正损失、mask 与 teacher stop-gradient；三种子机制结果见 metrics/mechanism-seeds42-44.json。未运行 ALFWorld/WebShop 或 GRPO warm start，不能宣称论文最高 +14.0 点结果。  Agentic RL On-policy distillation 表征对齐 LLM 后训练 教师与纠错：额外信息何时能帮到学生 PR-OPD为什么对同一response做普通与hindsight skill两次forward，而不是直接模仿技能文本？ skill是完成轨迹后得到的训练专属视图，目标是比较它怎样改变同一响应各层各token表示，再蒸馏到无skill学生。若改成复制技能文本或另一条教师答案，就换了监督对象。教师分支停止梯度，并与任务奖励结合，推理时移除skill和教师。 教学例子：失败复盘总结“先验证工具返回格式”，可以让教师借此重新解释旧决策；学生训练后应在没有这条提示时自己做出判断。 2026-10-27">
<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/teacher-and-context/">LLM 后训练 / 教师与纠错：额外信息何时能帮到学生</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-level">核心机制</p>
<h2 id="qa-ceecfd34d31cf4a4">PR-OPD为什么对同一response做普通与hindsight skill两次forward，而不是直接模仿技能文本？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Apr-opd">PR-OPD: Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · University of Florida</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>skill是完成轨迹后得到的训练专属视图，目标是比较它怎样改变同一响应各层各token表示，再蒸馏到无skill学生。若改成复制技能文本或另一条教师答案，就换了监督对象。教师分支停止梯度，并与任务奖励结合，推理时移除skill和教师。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>失败复盘总结“先验证工具返回格式”，可以让教师借此重新解释旧决策；学生训练后应在没有这条提示时自己做出判断。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36642">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.36642-pr-opd/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-ceecfd34d31cf4a4">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:pr-opd" data-paper-title="PR-OPD: Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="implementation" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/teacher-and-context" data-search="PR-OPD: Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning LLM 后训练 University of Florida 2026-09-29 GRPO warm start 后，策略为每条已完成轨迹写一条 hindsight skill，并对同一 response 做普通 context 与 skill context 两次 forward。后者是 stop-gradient teacher；PR-OPD 在每层、每个 response token 对齐投影 hidden state，再与 reward objective 组合。推理时 skill 和 teacher 分支都移除。 复现级别：L1 表征对齐目标。复现级别：L1 表征对齐目标。实现多层、多 response-token 的 stop-gradient privileged alignment。测试覆盖相同表征时零损失、不同表征时正损失、mask 与 teacher stop-gradient；三种子机制结果见 metrics/mechanism-seeds42-44.json。未运行 ALFWorld/WebShop 或 GRPO warm start，不能宣称论文最高 +14.0 点结果。  Agentic RL On-policy distillation 表征对齐 LLM 后训练 教师与纠错：额外信息何时能帮到学生 PR-OPD逐层投影hidden对齐需注意哪些mask？ 只对同一response有效词元和对应层处理，观察或padding不能算学生生成监督。skill来自已完成训练轨迹，不能把gold plan直接当自生成技能；本地核不代表完整Agent训练。 例如教师多出的skill token不与学生response按原位置硬对齐。 2026-10-27">
<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/teacher-and-context/">LLM 后训练 / 教师与纠错：额外信息何时能帮到学生</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-level">实现细节</p>
<h2 id="qa-1ed3d42bb6433d2a">PR-OPD逐层投影hidden对齐需注意哪些mask？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Apr-opd">PR-OPD: Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · University of Florida</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>只对同一response有效词元和对应层处理，观察或padding不能算学生生成监督。skill来自已完成训练轨迹，不能把gold plan直接当自生成技能；本地核不代表完整Agent训练。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如教师多出的skill token不与学生response按原位置硬对齐。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36642">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.36642-pr-opd/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-1ed3d42bb6433d2a">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:pr-opd" data-paper-title="PR-OPD: Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="comparison" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/teacher-and-context" data-search="PR-OPD: Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning LLM 后训练 University of Florida 2026-09-29 GRPO warm start 后，策略为每条已完成轨迹写一条 hindsight skill，并对同一 response 做普通 context 与 skill context 两次 forward。后者是 stop-gradient teacher；PR-OPD 在每层、每个 response token 对齐投影 hidden state，再与 reward objective 组合。推理时 skill 和 teacher 分支都移除。 复现级别：L1 表征对齐目标。复现级别：L1 表征对齐目标。实现多层、多 response-token 的 stop-gradient privileged alignment。测试覆盖相同表征时零损失、不同表征时正损失、mask 与 teacher stop-gradient；三种子机制结果见 metrics/mechanism-seeds42-44.json。未运行 ALFWorld/WebShop 或 GRPO warm start，不能宣称论文最高 +14.0 点结果。  Agentic RL On-policy distillation 表征对齐 LLM 后训练 教师与纠错：额外信息何时能帮到学生 PR-OPD两次forward与把skill直接拼给学生训练有什么区别？ 普通context学生与skill教师分开，教师stop-gradient；若学生也读skill，就改变部署条件并可能只学依赖提示。表征匹配也不等于输出答案监督。 例如评测不再提供skill时，学生应靠参数，而非靠训练期额外文字。 2026-10-27">
<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/teacher-and-context/">LLM 后训练 / 教师与纠错：额外信息何时能帮到学生</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-level">方法对比</p>
<h2 id="qa-e5d6558b0b26dd06">PR-OPD两次forward与把skill直接拼给学生训练有什么区别？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Apr-opd">PR-OPD: Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · University of Florida</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>普通context学生与skill教师分开，教师stop-gradient；若学生也读skill，就改变部署条件并可能只学依赖提示。表征匹配也不等于输出答案监督。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如评测不再提供skill时，学生应靠参数，而非靠训练期额外文字。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36642">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.36642-pr-opd/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-e5d6558b0b26dd06">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:pr-opd" data-paper-title="PR-OPD: Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="basics" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/teacher-and-context" data-search="PR-OPD: Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning LLM 后训练 University of Florida 2026-09-29 GRPO warm start 后，策略为每条已完成轨迹写一条 hindsight skill，并对同一 response 做普通 context 与 skill context 两次 forward。后者是 stop-gradient teacher；PR-OPD 在每层、每个 response token 对齐投影 hidden state，再与 reward objective 组合。推理时 skill 和 teacher 分支都移除。 复现级别：L1 表征对齐目标。复现级别：L1 表征对齐目标。实现多层、多 response-token 的 stop-gradient privileged alignment。测试覆盖相同表征时零损失、不同表征时正损失、mask 与 teacher stop-gradient；三种子机制结果见 metrics/mechanism-seeds42-44.json。未运行 ALFWorld/WebShop 或 GRPO warm start，不能宣称论文最高 +14.0 点结果。  Agentic RL On-policy distillation 表征对齐 LLM 后训练 教师与纠错：额外信息何时能帮到学生 PR-OPD为什么蒸馏表征而非只对最终token分布？ hindsight skill让同一模型形成特权表示，逐层逐响应位置对齐投影hidden state，可传递内部结构信号，再与任务奖励结合。skill只供训练教师，推理去掉。 例如成功后归纳的工具原则帮助教师内部表征，不直接成为部署输入。 2026-10-27">
<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/teacher-and-context/">LLM 后训练 / 教师与纠错：额外信息何时能帮到学生</a></p>
<span id="paper-post-training-pr-opd-9c73d4f9" class="ar-learning-paper-anchor"></span>
<p class="ar-learning-level">基础理解</p>
<h2 id="qa-59a45194479a55f0">PR-OPD为什么蒸馏表征而非只对最终token分布？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Apr-opd">PR-OPD: Privileged Representation On-policy Self-Distillation for Agentic Reinforcement Learning</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · University of Florida</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>hindsight skill让同一模型形成特权表示，逐层逐响应位置对齐投影hidden state，可传递内部结构信号，再与任务奖励结合。skill只供训练教师，推理去掉。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如成功后归纳的工具原则帮助教师内部表征，不直接成为部署输入。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.36642">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.36642-pr-opd/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-59a45194479a55f0">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:oasis-opsd" data-paper-title="Overcoming Scaling Limits in On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="mechanism" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/student-trajectory-distillation" data-search="Overcoming Scaling Limits in On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning LLM 后训练 North South University 2026-09-29 OASIS 把“在哪里监督”和“teacher 看什么 context”解耦：从同一题的 on-policy rollouts 中选最短的已验证轨迹作为 scaffold；teacher context 优先使用另一条未验证尝试；没有 verified rollout 的题不产生训练信号。这样只需要最终答案 verifier，而不需要 gold solution。 复现级别：L1 选择与损失机制。复现级别：L1 选择与损失机制。实现 shortest verified scaffold、独立同题 context 和 clipped forward-KL。测试保证未验证短轨迹不会被误选、teacher context 与 scaffold 不同、mask 外 token 无梯度。三种子机制结果见 metrics/mechanism-seeds42-44.json。未运行 Qwen3 1.7B–8B rollout/training，属于机制实现，不宣称 AIME/HMMT 增益。  On-policy self-distillation 可验证推理 LLM 后训练 在策略蒸馏：沿学生实际走过的前缀学习 OASIS为什么用最短已验证轨迹作scaffold，却可把另一条未验证尝试放进教师上下文？ scaffold决定在哪条可信学生轨迹上监督，教师上下文决定额外参考什么，两者被刻意解耦。未验证尝试可以提供可比较思路，但不能自动成为正确解；没有任何verified rollout的题不产生该训练信号。只需最终答案验证，也不代表学生能读取gold solution。 教学例子：同题一条短回答已通过验收，另一条探索较长但未确认；可在短回答前缀上评分，同时让教师参考探索中的信息。 2026-10-27">
<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/student-trajectory-distillation/">LLM 后训练 / 在策略蒸馏：沿学生实际走过的前缀学习</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-level">核心机制</p>
<h2 id="qa-9e59a6d301d00681">OASIS为什么用最短已验证轨迹作scaffold，却可把另一条未验证尝试放进教师上下文？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Aoasis-opsd">Overcoming Scaling Limits in On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · North South University</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>scaffold决定在哪条可信学生轨迹上监督，教师上下文决定额外参考什么，两者被刻意解耦。未验证尝试可以提供可比较思路，但不能自动成为正确解；没有任何verified rollout的题不产生该训练信号。只需最终答案验证，也不代表学生能读取gold solution。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>同题一条短回答已通过验收，另一条探索较长但未确认；可在短回答前缀上评分，同时让教师参考探索中的信息。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37915">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.37915-oasis/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-9e59a6d301d00681">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:oasis-opsd" data-paper-title="Overcoming Scaling Limits in On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="implementation" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/student-trajectory-distillation" data-search="Overcoming Scaling Limits in On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning LLM 后训练 North South University 2026-09-29 OASIS 把“在哪里监督”和“teacher 看什么 context”解耦：从同一题的 on-policy rollouts 中选最短的已验证轨迹作为 scaffold；teacher context 优先使用另一条未验证尝试；没有 verified rollout 的题不产生训练信号。这样只需要最终答案 verifier，而不需要 gold solution。 复现级别：L1 选择与损失机制。复现级别：L1 选择与损失机制。实现 shortest verified scaffold、独立同题 context 和 clipped forward-KL。测试保证未验证短轨迹不会被误选、teacher context 与 scaffold 不同、mask 外 token 无梯度。三种子机制结果见 metrics/mechanism-seeds42-44.json。未运行 Qwen3 1.7B–8B rollout/training，属于机制实现，不宣称 AIME/HMMT 增益。  On-policy self-distillation 可验证推理 LLM 后训练 在策略蒸馏：沿学生实际走过的前缀学习 OASIS实现应在选scaffold前还是后按长度排序？ 必须先确认已验证资格，再从合格轨迹中取最短；先取最短后忽略失败会错选。teacher context与监督轨迹身份也需分别记录，不得把未来答案泄露给学生。 例如最短回答只有一句错误结论，不应压过较长但确实通过验证的轨迹。 2026-10-27">
<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/student-trajectory-distillation/">LLM 后训练 / 在策略蒸馏：沿学生实际走过的前缀学习</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-level">实现细节</p>
<h2 id="qa-ea4b4ea58811e49f">OASIS实现应在选scaffold前还是后按长度排序？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Aoasis-opsd">Overcoming Scaling Limits in On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · North South University</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>必须先确认已验证资格，再从合格轨迹中取最短；先取最短后忽略失败会错选。teacher context与监督轨迹身份也需分别记录，不得把未来答案泄露给学生。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如最短回答只有一句错误结论，不应压过较长但确实通过验证的轨迹。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37915">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.37915-oasis/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-ea4b4ea58811e49f">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>

<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/student-trajectory-distillation/">LLM 后训练 / 在策略蒸馏：沿学生实际走过的前缀学习</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-level">方法对比</p>
<h2 id="qa-3f6085d4cc26e952">OASIS没有gold solution，为何仍要求最终verifier？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Aoasis-opsd">Overcoming Scaling Limits in On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · North South University</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>它依赖rollout中出现可验证成功，才能选scaffold；不需完整标准步骤不表示不需正确性检查。没有任何verified轨迹时不产生训练信号，而非自封一条为正确。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如多个答案都未验过，不能仅因最短就称它是有效scaffold。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37915">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.37915-oasis/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-3f6085d4cc26e952">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:oasis-opsd" data-paper-title="Overcoming Scaling Limits in On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="basics" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/student-trajectory-distillation" data-search="Overcoming Scaling Limits in On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning LLM 后训练 North South University 2026-09-29 OASIS 把“在哪里监督”和“teacher 看什么 context”解耦：从同一题的 on-policy rollouts 中选最短的已验证轨迹作为 scaffold；teacher context 优先使用另一条未验证尝试；没有 verified rollout 的题不产生训练信号。这样只需要最终答案 verifier，而不需要 gold solution。 复现级别：L1 选择与损失机制。复现级别：L1 选择与损失机制。实现 shortest verified scaffold、独立同题 context 和 clipped forward-KL。测试保证未验证短轨迹不会被误选、teacher context 与 scaffold 不同、mask 外 token 无梯度。三种子机制结果见 metrics/mechanism-seeds42-44.json。未运行 Qwen3 1.7B–8B rollout/training，属于机制实现，不宣称 AIME/HMMT 增益。  On-policy self-distillation 可验证推理 LLM 后训练 在策略蒸馏：沿学生实际走过的前缀学习 OASIS为什么把scaffold与teacher context分开？ 监督位置选最短已验证轨迹，而教师上下文优先取另一条未验证尝试。何处学习与教师看到什么是两种选择，避免把两者机械绑定成同一标准解。 例如用一条简洁成功路线定位监督，却让教师借另一尝试提供不同条件线索。 2026-10-27">
<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/student-trajectory-distillation/">LLM 后训练 / 在策略蒸馏：沿学生实际走过的前缀学习</a></p>
<span id="paper-post-training-oasis-opsd-27f4197e" class="ar-learning-paper-anchor"></span>
<p class="ar-learning-level">基础理解</p>
<h2 id="qa-ec1a94a3565cdcc0">OASIS为什么把scaffold与teacher context分开？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Aoasis-opsd">Overcoming Scaling Limits in On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · North South University</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>监督位置选最短已验证轨迹，而教师上下文优先取另一条未验证尝试。何处学习与教师看到什么是两种选择，避免把两者机械绑定成同一标准解。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如用一条简洁成功路线定位监督，却让教师借另一尝试提供不同条件线索。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37915">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.37915-oasis/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-ec1a94a3565cdcc0">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:maestro-opd" data-paper-title="From Dissonance to Orchestration: Teacher Intervention in On-Policy Distillation" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="mechanism" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/teacher-and-context" data-search="From Dissonance to Orchestration: Teacher Intervention in On-Policy Distillation LLM 后训练 Nanyang Technological University 2026-09-29 MAESTRO 用教师 top-k 覆盖度和 Bhattacharyya 相似度构造逐 token Policy Disagreement Score，并对靠近响应起点的位置加权；教师只在高分歧位置介入，减少整段 teacher rollout 的固定开销。 复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。执行 top-k coverage/Bhattacharyya PDS；未生成 teacher rollouts。执行 top-k coverage/Bhattacharyya PDS；未生成 teacher rollouts。本地对照口径：基线为论文机制关闭或默认状态，实验组为开启对应核心算子；本批只验证不变量和状态转换，跨模型相对变化不适用。  On-policy distillation 教师介入 策略分歧 LLM 后训练 教师与纠错：额外信息何时能帮到学生 MAESTRO为什么把top-k覆盖与Bhattacharyya相似度同时用于教师介入判断？ 覆盖衡量学生候选是否包含教师支持，归一化相似度再看共同支持中的质量分配，两者不能相互替代。分歧分数与靠前位置权重帮助集中有限教师介入预算。分歧高只是需要关注的线索，不保证教师一定正确，本地PDS算子也没有生成完整教师rollout。 教学例子：两模型top-k词完全相同，却给这些词很不一样的概率；只看候选是否重叠，会误判它们没有重要分歧。 2026-10-27">
<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/teacher-and-context/">LLM 后训练 / 教师与纠错：额外信息何时能帮到学生</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-level">核心机制</p>
<h2 id="qa-d66864e0fc2fc51c">MAESTRO为什么把top-k覆盖与Bhattacharyya相似度同时用于教师介入判断？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Amaestro-opd">From Dissonance to Orchestration: Teacher Intervention in On-Policy Distillation</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · Nanyang Technological University</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>覆盖衡量学生候选是否包含教师支持，归一化相似度再看共同支持中的质量分配，两者不能相互替代。分歧分数与靠前位置权重帮助集中有限教师介入预算。分歧高只是需要关注的线索，不保证教师一定正确，本地PDS算子也没有生成完整教师rollout。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>两模型top-k词完全相同，却给这些词很不一样的概率；只看候选是否重叠，会误判它们没有重要分歧。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37510">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.37510-maestro/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-d66864e0fc2fc51c">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>

<h2 id="qa-0d5b4623fbf3f723">MAESTRO本地是否真的生成教师接管rollout？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Amaestro-opd">From Dissonance to Orchestration: Teacher Intervention in On-Policy Distillation</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · Nanyang Technological University</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>没有，只计算top-k覆盖、归一化相似度和PDS。真实介入还需模型生成、状态衔接与成本统计；不能从分数核通过推断已获得论文教师调用节约。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如人工输入两份概率得到高分，不表示系统已执行一次教师帮助。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37510">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.37510-maestro/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-0d5b4623fbf3f723">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:maestro-opd" data-paper-title="From Dissonance to Orchestration: Teacher Intervention in On-Policy Distillation" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="comparison" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/teacher-and-context" data-search="From Dissonance to Orchestration: Teacher Intervention in On-Policy Distillation LLM 后训练 Nanyang Technological University 2026-09-29 MAESTRO 用教师 top-k 覆盖度和 Bhattacharyya 相似度构造逐 token Policy Disagreement Score，并对靠近响应起点的位置加权；教师只在高分歧位置介入，减少整段 teacher rollout 的固定开销。 复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。执行 top-k coverage/Bhattacharyya PDS；未生成 teacher rollouts。执行 top-k coverage/Bhattacharyya PDS；未生成 teacher rollouts。本地对照口径：基线为论文机制关闭或默认状态，实验组为开启对应核心算子；本批只验证不变量和状态转换，跨模型相对变化不适用。  On-policy distillation 教师介入 策略分歧 LLM 后训练 教师与纠错：额外信息何时能帮到学生 覆盖度与Bhattacharyya相似度为何要一起看？ 覆盖关心教师支持是否落在学生候选中，相似度关心共同支持内的质量分配；单独一个会漏掉另一类差异。高PDS不保证教师路线一定优质。 例如候选身份都相同却权重完全相反，仍应视为有明显分歧。 2026-10-27">
<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/teacher-and-context/">LLM 后训练 / 教师与纠错：额外信息何时能帮到学生</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-level">方法对比</p>
<h2 id="qa-2d65dccc35ab4180">覆盖度与Bhattacharyya相似度为何要一起看？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Amaestro-opd">From Dissonance to Orchestration: Teacher Intervention in On-Policy Distillation</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · Nanyang Technological University</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>覆盖关心教师支持是否落在学生候选中，相似度关心共同支持内的质量分配；单独一个会漏掉另一类差异。高PDS不保证教师路线一定优质。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如候选身份都相同却权重完全相反，仍应视为有明显分歧。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37510">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.37510-maestro/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-2d65dccc35ab4180">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:maestro-opd" data-paper-title="From Dissonance to Orchestration: Teacher Intervention in On-Policy Distillation" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="basics" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/teacher-and-context" data-search="From Dissonance to Orchestration: Teacher Intervention in On-Policy Distillation LLM 后训练 Nanyang Technological University 2026-09-29 MAESTRO 用教师 top-k 覆盖度和 Bhattacharyya 相似度构造逐 token Policy Disagreement Score，并对靠近响应起点的位置加权；教师只在高分歧位置介入，减少整段 teacher rollout 的固定开销。 复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。执行 top-k coverage/Bhattacharyya PDS；未生成 teacher rollouts。执行 top-k coverage/Bhattacharyya PDS；未生成 teacher rollouts。本地对照口径：基线为论文机制关闭或默认状态，实验组为开启对应核心算子；本批只验证不变量和状态转换，跨模型相对变化不适用。  On-policy distillation 教师介入 策略分歧 LLM 后训练 教师与纠错：额外信息何时能帮到学生 MAESTRO为什么只在高分歧位置让教师介入？ 整段教师rollout昂贵，学生与教师top-k覆盖及相似度可定位更需要帮助的前缀，并偏重早期位置。介入策略是一种预算分配，不是所有分歧都等于学生错误。 例如开头分叉可能影响长后续，比末尾标点差异更值得有限教师计算。 2026-10-27">
<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/teacher-and-context/">LLM 后训练 / 教师与纠错：额外信息何时能帮到学生</a></p>
<span id="paper-post-training-maestro-opd-551f210d" class="ar-learning-paper-anchor"></span>
<p class="ar-learning-level">基础理解</p>
<h2 id="qa-3338a9b96bec70e1">MAESTRO为什么只在高分歧位置让教师介入？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Amaestro-opd">From Dissonance to Orchestration: Teacher Intervention in On-Policy Distillation</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · Nanyang Technological University</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>整段教师rollout昂贵，学生与教师top-k覆盖及相似度可定位更需要帮助的前缀，并偏重早期位置。介入策略是一种预算分配，不是所有分歧都等于学生错误。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如开头分叉可能影响长后续，比末尾标点差异更值得有限教师计算。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37510">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.37510-maestro/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-3338a9b96bec70e1">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:lego-opd" data-paper-title="LEGO-OPD: Factorized Teacher Composition for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="mechanism" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/teacher-and-context" data-search="LEGO-OPD: Factorized Teacher Composition for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation LLM 后训练 KAIST 2026-09-29 把语言专家作为 token prior，把 grounding 专家只作为视觉 likelihood，以乘积专家形式组成 OPD teacher，避免连同 VLM 语言偏差一起蒸馏。 复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。执行 factorized teacher composition；未加载 LLM/VLM teacher。执行 factorized teacher composition；未加载 LLM/VLM teacher。本地对照口径：基线为机制关闭或默认状态，实验组执行定义性算子；L1 不报告正式相对提升，百分比不适用。  OPD 多模态后训练 teacher composition LLM 后训练 教师与纠错：额外信息何时能帮到学生 LEGO-OPD为什么让语言专家给先验、视觉专家给似然，而不直接平均两个教师？ 语言专家负责一般词语和推理的先验，视觉专家提供与画面有关的证据修正；两者按专家乘积组成蒸馏目标，避免把视觉模型的语言偏差一起照搬。角色分解仍依赖视觉似然是否可靠，本地仅验证组合目标，不能据此认定已获得真实视觉能力。 例如识别杯子颜色时，语言专家让句子通顺，视觉专家提高画面所支持颜色的概率；这个例子解释分工，不代表实际识别成绩。 2026-10-27">
<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/teacher-and-context/">LLM 后训练 / 教师与纠错：额外信息何时能帮到学生</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-level">核心机制</p>
<h2 id="qa-0be0a85b3520122d">LEGO-OPD为什么让语言专家给先验、视觉专家给似然，而不直接平均两个教师？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Alego-opd">LEGO-OPD: Factorized Teacher Composition for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · KAIST</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>语言专家负责一般词语和推理的先验，视觉专家提供与画面有关的证据修正；两者按专家乘积组成蒸馏目标，避免把视觉模型的语言偏差一起照搬。角色分解仍依赖视觉似然是否可靠，本地仅验证组合目标，不能据此认定已获得真实视觉能力。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如识别杯子颜色时，语言专家让句子通顺，视觉专家提高画面所支持颜色的概率；这个例子解释分工，不代表实际识别成绩。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00333">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2610.00333-lego-opd/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-0be0a85b3520122d">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:lego-opd" data-paper-title="LEGO-OPD: Factorized Teacher Composition for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="implementation" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/teacher-and-context" data-search="LEGO-OPD: Factorized Teacher Composition for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation LLM 后训练 KAIST 2026-09-29 把语言专家作为 token prior，把 grounding 专家只作为视觉 likelihood，以乘积专家形式组成 OPD teacher，避免连同 VLM 语言偏差一起蒸馏。 复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。执行 factorized teacher composition；未加载 LLM/VLM teacher。执行 factorized teacher composition；未加载 LLM/VLM teacher。本地对照口径：基线为机制关闭或默认状态，实验组执行定义性算子；L1 不报告正式相对提升，百分比不适用。  OPD 多模态后训练 teacher composition LLM 后训练 教师与纠错：额外信息何时能帮到学生 LEGO本地是否真实加载语言与视觉专家？ 没有，只执行因子化目标组合。实现应对候选维度对齐、在log空间相加后归一，并区分视觉似然因子与完整VLM后验，不能把随机logits称为视觉能力。 例如两向量乘积能验公式，却没有让任何模型实际看图。 2026-10-27">
<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/teacher-and-context/">LLM 后训练 / 教师与纠错：额外信息何时能帮到学生</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-level">实现细节</p>
<h2 id="qa-0d2bbd06c7f56d04">LEGO本地是否真实加载语言与视觉专家？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Alego-opd">LEGO-OPD: Factorized Teacher Composition for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · KAIST</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>没有，只执行因子化目标组合。实现应对候选维度对齐、在log空间相加后归一，并区分视觉似然因子与完整VLM后验，不能把随机logits称为视觉能力。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如两向量乘积能验公式，却没有让任何模型实际看图。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00333">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2610.00333-lego-opd/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-0d2bbd06c7f56d04">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:lego-opd" data-paper-title="LEGO-OPD: Factorized Teacher Composition for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="comparison" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/teacher-and-context" data-search="LEGO-OPD: Factorized Teacher Composition for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation LLM 后训练 KAIST 2026-09-29 把语言专家作为 token prior，把 grounding 专家只作为视觉 likelihood，以乘积专家形式组成 OPD teacher，避免连同 VLM 语言偏差一起蒸馏。 复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。执行 factorized teacher composition；未加载 LLM/VLM teacher。执行 factorized teacher composition；未加载 LLM/VLM teacher。本地对照口径：基线为机制关闭或默认状态，实验组执行定义性算子；L1 不报告正式相对提升，百分比不适用。  OPD 多模态后训练 teacher composition LLM 后训练 教师与纠错：额外信息何时能帮到学生 专家乘积与两个教师概率平均有何不同？ 乘积强调两因素共同支持并在log空间相加，平均则混合两套完整预测。若把grounding完整语言输出平均进去，可能重新引入想避免的语言偏差。 例如视觉只修正颜色证据，不应同时决定所有连接词的写法。 2026-10-27">
<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/teacher-and-context/">LLM 后训练 / 教师与纠错：额外信息何时能帮到学生</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-level">方法对比</p>
<h2 id="qa-16ed41f70e40a9e1">专家乘积与两个教师概率平均有何不同？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Alego-opd">LEGO-OPD: Factorized Teacher Composition for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · KAIST</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>乘积强调两因素共同支持并在log空间相加，平均则混合两套完整预测。若把grounding完整语言输出平均进去，可能重新引入想避免的语言偏差。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如视觉只修正颜色证据，不应同时决定所有连接词的写法。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00333">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2610.00333-lego-opd/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-16ed41f70e40a9e1">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:lego-opd" data-paper-title="LEGO-OPD: Factorized Teacher Composition for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="basics" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/teacher-and-context" data-search="LEGO-OPD: Factorized Teacher Composition for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation LLM 后训练 KAIST 2026-09-29 把语言专家作为 token prior，把 grounding 专家只作为视觉 likelihood，以乘积专家形式组成 OPD teacher，避免连同 VLM 语言偏差一起蒸馏。 复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。执行 factorized teacher composition；未加载 LLM/VLM teacher。执行 factorized teacher composition；未加载 LLM/VLM teacher。本地对照口径：基线为机制关闭或默认状态，实验组执行定义性算子；L1 不报告正式相对提升，百分比不适用。  OPD 多模态后训练 teacher composition LLM 后训练 教师与纠错：额外信息何时能帮到学生 LEGO-OPD为什么把教师拆成语言与grounding两种角色？ 多模态教师可能同时带有语言和视觉偏差，分解后语言模型负责先验，grounding只提供视觉似然修正，让监督来源更清楚。它仍需可靠的视觉专家。 例如句子该怎样表达与杯子实际是什么颜色，来自不同信息。 2026-10-27">

<p class="ar-learning-level">基础理解</p>
<h2 id="qa-d289372d6af6441f">LEGO-OPD为什么把教师拆成语言与grounding两种角色？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Alego-opd">LEGO-OPD: Factorized Teacher Composition for Multimodal On-Policy Distillation</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · KAIST</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>多模态教师可能同时带有语言和视觉偏差，分解后语言模型负责先验，grounding只提供视觉似然修正，让监督来源更清楚。它仍需可靠的视觉专家。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如句子该怎样表达与杯子实际是什么颜色，来自不同信息。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>

</details>
</article>

<p class="ar-learning-level">核心机制</p>
<h2 id="qa-b2efc7ad19f40b08">IPD逐token混合师生概率，为什么不等同于整条回答随机选一个教师或学生来生成？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Aipd">Interpolated Policy Distillation: A Controllable Continuum Between Off-Policy and On-Policy Distillation</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · WeChat Vision, Tencent</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>条件分布在每个前缀处插值，后续状态随已采到的token改变；整条轨迹只选一次来源，会产生另一种序列分布。概率混合也不同于logits平均。精确采到目标混合策略需要对应采样协议，本地端点与归一化检查没有复现高吞吐speculative sampler。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>第一步可能从教师更支持的词采到，第二步仍按新前缀重新混合；并不是开头掷一次硬币后整段只听同一个模型。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37170">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.37170-ipd/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-b2efc7ad19f40b08">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>

<p class="ar-learning-level">实现细节</p>
<h2 id="qa-d048feb0beeb9dd5">IPD本地验证的端点是否包含高吞吐投机采样器？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Aipd">Interpolated Policy Distillation: A Controllable Continuum Between Off-Policy and On-Policy Distillation</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · WeChat Vision, Tencent</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>没有，只执行精确token mixture的端点、归一与总变差关系；γ零为学生、一为教师。原文验证感知speculative sampler与完整训练仍未复现。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如能算出混合向量，不表示真实模型能以论文吞吐采出它。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>

<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/student-trajectory-distillation/">LLM 后训练 / 在策略蒸馏：沿学生实际走过的前缀学习</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-level">方法对比</p>
<h2 id="qa-dc070c60c12b0237">token分布混合与整条轨迹二选一混合一样吗？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Aipd">Interpolated Policy Distillation: A Controllable Continuum Between Off-Policy and On-Policy Distillation</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · WeChat Vision, Tencent</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>不一样。逐步混合允许同条轨迹交替师生偏好，轨迹级先选一个模型则整段来自同一策略。它们的联合状态分布通常不同。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如第一步偏学生、第二步偏教师的路径，在整段固定选模型时未必同样可达。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>

</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:ipd" data-paper-title="Interpolated Policy Distillation: A Controllable Continuum Between Off-Policy and On-Policy Distillation" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="basics" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/student-trajectory-distillation" data-search="Interpolated Policy Distillation: A Controllable Continuum Between Off-Policy and On-Policy Distillation LLM 后训练 WeChat Vision, Tencent 2026-09-29 在每个 token 状态把 student 与 teacher 分布按插值，从纯 on-policy 连续过渡到 off-policy teacher；论文再用验证感知的 speculative sampler 精确采样该目标策略。 高吞吐 speculative sampler 和模型训练未复现。复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。执行精确 token mixture；高吞吐 speculative sampler 和模型训练未复现。执行精确 token mixture；高吞吐 speculative sampler 和模型训练未复现。本地对照口径：基线为论文机制关闭或默认状态，实验组为开启对应核心算子；本批只验证不变量和状态转换，跨模型相对变化不适用。  策略蒸馏 分布插值 Speculative sampling LLM 后训练 在策略蒸馏：沿学生实际走过的前缀学习 IPD为什么插值师生采样分布？ 纯学生状态与纯教师状态各有覆盖取舍，逐状态混合提供连续控制的采样政策。γ调节数据来自何种分布，不只是对两个损失做加权平均。 例如学生偶尔走自己路线，教师也可给另一些下一词选择，比例可控。 2026-10-27">

<span id="paper-post-training-ipd-4481efec" class="ar-learning-paper-anchor"></span>
<p class="ar-learning-level">基础理解</p>
<h2 id="qa-cac94113033ac8b7">IPD为什么插值师生采样分布？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Aipd">Interpolated Policy Distillation: A Controllable Continuum Between Off-Policy and On-Policy Distillation</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · WeChat Vision, Tencent</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>纯学生状态与纯教师状态各有覆盖取舍，逐状态混合提供连续控制的采样政策。γ调节数据来自何种分布，不只是对两个损失做加权平均。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如学生偶尔走自己路线，教师也可给另一些下一词选择，比例可控。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37170">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.37170-ipd/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-cac94113033ac8b7">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:graft" data-paper-title="Learning Beyond What You Sample: Off-Policy-Aware Cross-Model Trajectory Exchange for RLVR" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="mechanism" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/policy-optimization" data-search="Learning Beyond What You Sample: Off-Policy-Aware Cross-Model Trajectory Exchange for RLVR LLM 后训练 KAIST 2026-09-29 当 receiver 的 rollout group 全错、peer 在同题同时有成功和失败轨迹时，GRAFT 用完整 peer group 替换无信号组并保留 peer 内部 advantage。跨 tokenizer 的策略错配通过序列平均 log-likelihood compatibility 加权，再用 token importance ratio clipping 限制更新。 复现级别：L1 目标机制。复现级别：L1 目标机制。实现 peer compatibility gate、source advantage 保留与 token ratio clipping。本地目标检查低兼容 peer 被降权、ratio 越界被截断且 advantage 不回传；三种子机制结果见 metrics/mechanism-seeds42-44.json。未进行双模型 GRPO 联训或五个数学 benchmark，故不宣称论文平均 +2.1 分收益。  RLVR 跨模型轨迹交换 离策略校正 LLM 后训练 策略优化：谁在采样，谁在被更新 GRAFT为什么交换同题完整peer组，而不只挑peer的一条成功回答？ receiver全错组缺少区分信号，完整peer组同时保留成功与失败及其内部相对优势。只取成功例会改变组结构和信用。跨模型尤其跨tokenizer时，还需序列兼容性与token比率裁剪处理错配；交换来的数据不能被标成receiver自己的在策略采样。 教学例子：模型甲同题全错，模型乙有对有错。把乙的整组连同组内信用交给甲学习，与单独塞入一份标准答案不同。 2026-10-27">
<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/policy-optimization/">LLM 后训练 / 策略优化：谁在采样，谁在被更新</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-level">核心机制</p>
<h2 id="qa-4a8a72e7c33e77d4">GRAFT为什么交换同题完整peer组，而不只挑peer的一条成功回答？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Agraft">Learning Beyond What You Sample: Off-Policy-Aware Cross-Model Trajectory Exchange for RLVR</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · KAIST</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>receiver全错组缺少区分信号，完整peer组同时保留成功与失败及其内部相对优势。只取成功例会改变组结构和信用。跨模型尤其跨tokenizer时，还需序列兼容性与token比率裁剪处理错配；交换来的数据不能被标成receiver自己的在策略采样。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>模型甲同题全错，模型乙有对有错。把乙的整组连同组内信用交给甲学习，与单独塞入一份标准答案不同。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37868">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.37868-graft/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-4a8a72e7c33e77d4">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:graft" data-paper-title="Learning Beyond What You Sample: Off-Policy-Aware Cross-Model Trajectory Exchange for RLVR" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="implementation" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/policy-optimization" data-search="Learning Beyond What You Sample: Off-Policy-Aware Cross-Model Trajectory Exchange for RLVR LLM 后训练 KAIST 2026-09-29 当 receiver 的 rollout group 全错、peer 在同题同时有成功和失败轨迹时，GRAFT 用完整 peer group 替换无信号组并保留 peer 内部 advantage。跨 tokenizer 的策略错配通过序列平均 log-likelihood compatibility 加权，再用 token importance ratio clipping 限制更新。 复现级别：L1 目标机制。复现级别：L1 目标机制。实现 peer compatibility gate、source advantage 保留与 token ratio clipping。本地目标检查低兼容 peer 被降权、ratio 越界被截断且 advantage 不回传；三种子机制结果见 metrics/mechanism-seeds42-44.json。未进行双模型 GRPO 联训或五个数学 benchmark，故不宣称论文平均 +2.1 分收益。  RLVR 跨模型轨迹交换 离策略校正 LLM 后训练 策略优化：谁在采样，谁在被更新 跨tokenizer的GRAFT为什么先用序列平均似然衡量兼容性？ 不同分词造成词元级一一对应困难，序列平均似然提供整体兼容信号，再用重要性比裁剪限制更新。它不使两模型策略自动相同，来源、组内优势和文本重评分需可追踪。 例如同一句话被拆成不同数量词元，不能按位置直接相减两个模型词元概率。 2026-10-27">
<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/policy-optimization/">LLM 后训练 / 策略优化：谁在采样，谁在被更新</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-level">实现细节</p>
<h2 id="qa-a391696ae8153767">跨tokenizer的GRAFT为什么先用序列平均似然衡量兼容性？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Agraft">Learning Beyond What You Sample: Off-Policy-Aware Cross-Model Trajectory Exchange for RLVR</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · KAIST</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>不同分词造成词元级一一对应困难，序列平均似然提供整体兼容信号，再用重要性比裁剪限制更新。它不使两模型策略自动相同，来源、组内优势和文本重评分需可追踪。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如同一句话被拆成不同数量词元，不能按位置直接相减两个模型词元概率。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动；例子用于解释机制。</p>

</article>

<h2 id="qa-18fb1d6cc0e5ef2d">借完整peer组与只塞一条成功答案有何差别？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Agraft">Learning Beyond What You Sample: Off-Policy-Aware Cross-Model Trajectory Exchange for RLVR</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · KAIST</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>完整替换保留peer原组内部优势关系；只加正例会改变组分布及信用基准。借用仍是跨策略数据，不能标成receiver自身的on-policy生成。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如peer失败轨迹也保留，才能解释为什么组内成功轨迹获得相对正优势。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37868">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.37868-graft/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-18fb1d6cc0e5ef2d">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>

<h2 id="qa-bfafd4bf9c31e789">GRAFT什么时候才借用peer轨迹组？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Agraft">Learning Beyond What You Sample: Off-Policy-Aware Cross-Model Trajectory Exchange for RLVR</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · KAIST</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>receiver全失败而peer同题组内既有成功又有失败时，才有可迁移的相对优势信号。不是每次都借最强模型答案，也不是只复制peer的一条正确轨迹。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如receiver四条都错，peer组内有对有错，后者才提供组内可区分反馈。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动；例子用于解释机制。</p>

</details>
</article>

<h2 id="qa-f584461fdb668a3b">GATS为什么使用滞后一拍的学生成功率，并在赶上教师后永久撤出教师？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Agats">Guide, Then Let Go: Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling for Sparse-Reward Agentic RL</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · Dalian University of Technology / Kuaishou</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>滞后移动平均避免当前批次结果立即改变同批教师权重，固定教师参考使差距有稳定基准。差距缩小时蒸馏线性减弱，达到参考后永久关闭教师而继续奖励训练，避免短期波动反复开关。成功率受估计噪声影响，本地只验证调度状态机。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如本轮表现改善，下轮才减少指导；一旦达到设定教师参考，即使随后小幅波动也不重新叫回教师，这与逐批动态开关不同。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>

</details>
</article>

<h2 id="qa-3efcce80c343cefb">GATS为什么用滞后一拍学生EMA与固定教师尾部成功率？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Agats">Guide, Then Let Go: Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling for Sparse-Reward Agentic RL</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · Dalian University of Technology / Kuaishou</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>当前批奖励不能即时反向改变同批调度，固定参照使差距可解释。需处理教师基准为零等边界，当前仅验证调度核，未执行Qwen Agent RL。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如先完成本批记录，下一批权重再读更新后EMA，避免数据时序混乱。</p>

<h2 id="qa-7be6d244589f428f">GATS永久withdrawal与每批按成功率重新开关有什么区别？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Agats">Guide, Then Let Go: Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling for Sparse-Reward Agentic RL</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · Dalian University of Technology / Kuaishou</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>永久状态避免短期波动反复调用教师，动态开关可在下降后恢复指导，二者政策不同。成功率有估计噪声，不能把一次达到就解释成所有能力超过教师。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如下一批稍降也不会重启教师，这是状态机规定而非忘记调用。</p>

<h2 id="qa-1dae826119dc52c7">GATS为什么让教师权重随学生差距下降？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Agats">Guide, Then Let Go: Gap-Adaptive Teacher Scheduling for Sparse-Reward Agentic RL</a></p>

<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>

<h2 id="qa-4852debd06b0bfd3">FlowMap-OPD为什么冻结rollout状态，只让比较kernel向学生反传？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Aflowmap-opd">FlowMap-OPD: Rollout-Kernel Separation for On-Policy Distillation of Few-Step Flow-Map Generators</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · Georgia Institute of Technology</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>rollout负责提供符合所需边缘分布的状态，局部kernel负责在这些状态比较flow map或速度，两者承担不同职责。若沿状态生成路径也反传，就增加了未定义的轨迹梯度项，改变估计器。状态虽停止梯度，后续仍可由更新策略重新采集，并非永久固定数据。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>先由当前生成器采一批中间状态，再冻结它们做局部教师比较；不应让该次局部损失回头穿过整个状态采样过程。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37851">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.37851-flowmap-opd/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-4852debd06b0bfd3">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>

<h2 id="qa-4d68bfc6fd93ff35">本地FlowMap核能代表真实图像flow-map生成器训练吗？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Aflowmap-opd">FlowMap-OPD: Rollout-Kernel Separation for On-Policy Distillation of Few-Step Flow-Map Generators</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · Georgia Institute of Technology</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>不能，当前只验证状态detach和局部KL路径，没有图像生成器训练。教师应冻结，rollout状态边缘条件由调用方承担，随机状态并不自动满足论文假设。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如给一个任意向量算KL，不能证明它来自正确的生成分布。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37851">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.37851-flowmap-opd/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-4d68bfc6fd93ff35">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>

<p class="ar-learning-level">方法对比</p>
<h2 id="qa-645bf5c6a9169235">rollout-state detach与端到端穿过采样器有什么区别？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Aflowmap-opd">FlowMap-OPD: Rollout-Kernel Separation for On-Policy Distillation of Few-Step Flow-Map Generators</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · Georgia Institute of Technology</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>detach只优化局部kernel的学生参数，不沿产生状态的路径传播；端到端会引入额外状态依赖梯度。两者是不同目标近似，不能仅看同一loss数值判断等价。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如当前模型既影响状态又影响预测，冻结状态会有意切掉前一条通路。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37851">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.37851-flowmap-opd/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-645bf5c6a9169235">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>

<h2 id="qa-56ef347f59071d0c">FlowMap-OPD为何分开rollout分布和优化kernel？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Aflowmap-opd">FlowMap-OPD: Rollout-Kernel Separation for On-Policy Distillation of Few-Step Flow-Map Generators</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · Georgia Institute of Technology</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>采样部分负责给出具有规定边缘的状态，局部kernel负责在状态上比较师生流映射或速度。分离可澄清何处提供数据、何处求导，不能任意把采样路径也反传。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如先拿到一个冻结生成状态，再比较两模型在该状态的局部预测。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37851">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.37851-flowmap-opd/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-56ef347f59071d0c">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:drift-opd" data-paper-title="DriftOPD: Sequence-Level Reverse-KL Distillation for One-Step VLA Policies" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="mechanism" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/student-trajectory-distillation" data-search="DriftOPD: Sequence-Level Reverse-KL Distillation for One-Step VLA Policies LLM 后训练 KAIST 2026-09-29 把序列级 reverse-KL 拆成当前 chunk 的一步 reverse-KL 与刻画长期动作后果的 future potential；critic 从离线 demonstrations 学习。 复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。执行 objective 分解和 teacher stop-gradient；未运行机器人环境。执行 objective 分解和 teacher stop-gradient；未运行机器人环境。本地对照口径：基线为机制关闭或默认状态，实验组执行定义性算子；L1 不报告正式相对提升，百分比不适用。  OPD VLA 长程信用 LLM 后训练 在策略蒸馏：沿学生实际走过的前缀学习 DriftOPD为什么在当前动作chunk的reverse-KL之外，还加入future potential？ 一步动作匹配只能比较眼前分布，无法完整反映动作对后续状态的影响。future potential由离线示范学习的critic估计长期后果，使序列级目标分解保留时间信息。critic质量和示范覆盖仍是前提，本地目标分解并未运行机器人环境验证长期控制。 教学例子：两个抓取动作当下都像教师，一个却把物体推到后续够不到的位置；仅看当前chunk相似度可能分不出长期差别。 2026-10-27">

<p class="ar-learning-level">核心机制</p>
<h2 id="qa-1bd738afe55776dc">DriftOPD为什么在当前动作chunk的reverse-KL之外，还加入future potential？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Adrift-opd">DriftOPD: Sequence-Level Reverse-KL Distillation for One-Step VLA Policies</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · KAIST</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>一步动作匹配只能比较眼前分布，无法完整反映动作对后续状态的影响。future potential由离线示范学习的critic估计长期后果，使序列级目标分解保留时间信息。critic质量和示范覆盖仍是前提，本地目标分解并未运行机器人环境验证长期控制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>两个抓取动作当下都像教师，一个却把物体推到后续够不到的位置；仅看当前chunk相似度可能分不出长期差别。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.00317">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2610.00317-drift-opd/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-1bd738afe55776dc">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>

<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/student-trajectory-distillation/">LLM 后训练 / 在策略蒸馏：沿学生实际走过的前缀学习</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-level">实现细节</p>
<h2 id="qa-470a921fb5aecf61">DriftOPD本地是否执行机器人环境闭环？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Adrift-opd">DriftOPD: Sequence-Level Reverse-KL Distillation for One-Step VLA Policies</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · KAIST</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>未执行，只验证目标分解和教师停止梯度。真实升级还需离线示范训练未来critic、动作chunk与状态对齐及环境评估，不能把候选核当VLA部署。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如计算未来势的符号项，不等于机械臂已经按该势完成任务。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>

<h2 id="qa-43dfa00e793b7ee1">future potential与直接加当前动作奖励有什么差别？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Adrift-opd">DriftOPD: Sequence-Level Reverse-KL Distillation for One-Step VLA Policies</a></p>

<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>前者估计后续动作后果，是序列分解的一部分；即时奖只描述当前表现。近似critic误差会影响指导，不能把加一项value自动等同精确序列KL。</p>

<h2 id="qa-70c7f54da4753f4c">DriftOPD为什么在当前chunk蒸馏之外加入future potential？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Adrift-opd">DriftOPD: Sequence-Level Reverse-KL Distillation for One-Step VLA Policies</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · KAIST</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>动作影响后续机器人状态，当前一步接近教师不保证长期后果相近。序列reverse KL分解引入未来势，使短步策略也考虑后续影响，critic来自离线示范。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如当前抓取姿势看似合理，却可能导致后面放置无法完成。</p>

<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:dr-opd" data-paper-title="Dr. OPD: Learning What to Follow for Optimal On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="mechanism" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/student-trajectory-distillation" data-search="Dr. OPD: Learning What to Follow for Optimal On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models LLM 后训练 Rutgers University 2026-09-29 普通 OPD 对每个 teacher token 信号等权，但改正关键推理错误与替换同义措辞的下游价值不同。Dr. OPD 用双层优化定义“更新学生后预期 reward 最大”的 token 权重，并在每轮先闭式更新权重，再执行一次加权 OPD。 复现级别：L1 目标函数。复现级别：L1 目标函数。实现 discrepancy × reward-JVP token credit、闭式权重更新和加权 reverse-KL；未进行论文规模的双层迭代训练。本地验证权重有界、梯度有限和不同 token credit 能产生差异化权重。A100 脱敏记录见 ../../gpu-validations/dr-opd-a100-20260930.json。  On-policy distillation 双层优化 Token 权重 LLM 后训练 在策略蒸馏：沿学生实际走过的前缀学习 Dr. OPD为什么按下游reward对token更新方向的JVP加权，而不只看师生分歧大小？ 分歧大可能只是措辞不同，未必值得花监督预算；JVP估计沿该纠偏方向对下游回报的影响，把学习价值与差异结合。闭式权重再经限制和归一化后用于OPD。它依赖所用回报与局部近似，不能把较大权重解释为已证实的全局因果贡献。 教学例子：老师学生对结论运算符与礼貌词都分歧，只有前者改变任务奖励；单看分歧大小可能把预算花在无关表述上。 2026-10-27">
<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/student-trajectory-distillation/">LLM 后训练 / 在策略蒸馏：沿学生实际走过的前缀学习</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-level">核心机制</p>
<h2 id="qa-7abf58626c0e76d6">Dr. OPD为什么按下游reward对token更新方向的JVP加权，而不只看师生分歧大小？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Adr-opd">Dr. OPD: Learning What to Follow for Optimal On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · Rutgers University</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>分歧大可能只是措辞不同，未必值得花监督预算；JVP估计沿该纠偏方向对下游回报的影响，把学习价值与差异结合。闭式权重再经限制和归一化后用于OPD。它依赖所用回报与局部近似，不能把较大权重解释为已证实的全局因果贡献。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>老师学生对结论运算符与礼貌词都分歧，只有前者改变任务奖励；单看分歧大小可能把预算花在无关表述上。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38025">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.38025-dr-opd/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-7abf58626c0e76d6">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:dr-opd" data-paper-title="Dr. OPD: Learning What to Follow for Optimal On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="implementation" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/student-trajectory-distillation" data-search="Dr. OPD: Learning What to Follow for Optimal On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models LLM 后训练 Rutgers University 2026-09-29 普通 OPD 对每个 teacher token 信号等权，但改正关键推理错误与替换同义措辞的下游价值不同。Dr. OPD 用双层优化定义“更新学生后预期 reward 最大”的 token 权重，并在每轮先闭式更新权重，再执行一次加权 OPD。 复现级别：L1 目标函数。复现级别：L1 目标函数。实现 discrepancy × reward-JVP token credit、闭式权重更新和加权 reverse-KL；未进行论文规模的双层迭代训练。本地验证权重有界、梯度有限和不同 token credit 能产生差异化权重。A100 脱敏记录见 ../../gpu-validations/dr-opd-a100-20260930.json。  On-policy distillation 双层优化 Token 权重 LLM 后训练 在策略蒸馏：沿学生实际走过的前缀学习 Dr. OPD权重更新与学生更新应怎样排序？ 每轮先由固定批信号闭式求权重、裁剪并均值归一，再执行加权RKL学生更新。不能在同一步让学生通过权重反向改变选择目标，本地d乘g是明确代理记号。 例如先定本批该学哪处，再更新学生，而不是把评价权重也一起随意下降。 2026-10-27">
<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/student-trajectory-distillation/">LLM 后训练 / 在策略蒸馏：沿学生实际走过的前缀学习</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-level">实现细节</p>
<h2 id="qa-370359f1be3a4044">Dr. OPD权重更新与学生更新应怎样排序？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Adr-opd">Dr. OPD: Learning What to Follow for Optimal On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · Rutgers University</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>每轮先由固定批信号闭式求权重、裁剪并均值归一，再执行加权RKL学生更新。不能在同一步让学生通过权重反向改变选择目标，本地d乘g是明确代理记号。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如先定本批该学哪处，再更新学生，而不是把评价权重也一起随意下降。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38025">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.38025-dr-opd/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-370359f1be3a4044">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="post-training:dr-opd" data-paper-title="Dr. OPD: Learning What to Follow for Optimal On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="comparison" data-domain="post-training" data-theme="post-training" data-topic="post-training/student-trajectory-distillation" data-search="Dr. OPD: Learning What to Follow for Optimal On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models LLM 后训练 Rutgers University 2026-09-29 普通 OPD 对每个 teacher token 信号等权，但改正关键推理错误与替换同义措辞的下游价值不同。Dr. OPD 用双层优化定义“更新学生后预期 reward 最大”的 token 权重，并在每轮先闭式更新权重，再执行一次加权 OPD。 复现级别：L1 目标函数。复现级别：L1 目标函数。实现 discrepancy × reward-JVP token credit、闭式权重更新和加权 reverse-KL；未进行论文规模的双层迭代训练。本地验证权重有界、梯度有限和不同 token credit 能产生差异化权重。A100 脱敏记录见 ../../gpu-validations/dr-opd-a100-20260930.json。  On-policy distillation 双层优化 Token 权重 LLM 后训练 在策略蒸馏：沿学生实际走过的前缀学习 reward JVP加权与只按KL分歧挑词有什么区别？ 分歧衡量差多少，JVP描述沿相关更新方向回报可能怎样变。组合同时考虑差距与下游价值，但近似梯度不是独立正确性保证，不能免去验证。 例如教师学生对无关措辞分歧大，收益方向仍可能很弱。 2026-10-27">

<p class="ar-learning-level">方法对比</p>
<h2 id="qa-98aef755078f6688">reward JVP加权与只按KL分歧挑词有什么区别？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Adr-opd">Dr. OPD: Learning What to Follow for Optimal On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · Rutgers University</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>分歧衡量差多少，JVP描述沿相关更新方向回报可能怎样变。组合同时考虑差距与下游价值，但近似梯度不是独立正确性保证，不能免去验证。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如教师学生对无关措辞分歧大，收益方向仍可能很弱。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>

<h2 id="qa-e8d09aba2b99ef7e">Dr. OPD为什么给不同teacher token不同权重？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Adr-opd">Dr. OPD: Learning What to Follow for Optimal On-Policy Distillation of Large Language Models</a></p>

<p class="ar-learning-level">核心机制</p>
<h2 id="qa-6de6ac398dbe65f4">AdviSD为什么固定同一条执行器回答，比较有无建议时的概率？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Aadvisd">AdviSD: Learning to Advise Frontier LLMs via Targeted Multi-Turn Self-Distillation</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · University of Southern California</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>固定回答能把差异集中到建议如何改变执行器对这条回答的偏好，避免两次生成的随机差异混入效果估计。顾问只学习超过校准阈值的反思建议，执行器保持冻结。概率提升是筛选信号，不等价于任务成功，阈值也依赖所用建议分布。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如执行器已给出一次工具调用，分别在有建议和无建议的上下文中给这次调用打分；不另生成两次回答后直接相减。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38142">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.38142-advisd/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-6de6ac398dbe65f4">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>

<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/teacher-and-context/">LLM 后训练 / 教师与纠错：额外信息何时能帮到学生</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-level">实现细节</p>
<h2 id="qa-6f3d700f9d4b64e0">AdviSD有无建议对照能分别重新生成两条回答吗？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Aadvisd">AdviSD: Learning to Advise Frontier LLMs via Targeted Multi-Turn Self-Distillation</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · University of Southern California</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>不能替代固定记录响应的成对评分，否则随机生成差异混入建议效应。按同一响应有效词元均值计算，阈值来自donor绝对contrast分位，本地未调用真实executor。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如一边生成长代码另一边生成短代码，分数差不再仅是上下文建议作用。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38142">原论文</a> · <a href="../../post-training/2609.38142-advisd/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-6f3d700f9d4b64e0">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>

<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/post-training/teacher-and-context/">LLM 后训练 / 教师与纠错：额外信息何时能帮到学生</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-level">方法对比</p>
<h2 id="qa-f29a6d7748aa8d87">建议有影响与建议提高成功率是一回事吗？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Aadvisd">AdviSD: Learning to Advise Frontier LLMs via Targeted Multi-Turn Self-Distillation</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · University of Southern California</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>不是，似然对照只测对同一记录响应的偏好改变，影响大小并不独立证明结果更好。donor校准筛掉弱变化，仍需任务评估检查有益性。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如建议令执行器更喜欢原动作，但原动作本身也可能是错的。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>

</details>
</article>

<h2 id="qa-9689d817dbfc3cb9">AdviSD为什么只训练advisor而冻结executor？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=post-training%3Aadvisd">AdviSD: Learning to Advise Frontier LLMs via Targeted Multi-Turn Self-Distillation</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · University of Southern California</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>目标是学会给固定强执行器有用建议，将改进归因到顾问而非同时改变执行器。多轮反思提供候选建议，但只有足够影响执行器决策的部分进入自蒸馏。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如工具调用模型不改权重，只改善旁边提醒它检查参数的顾问。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>

</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="foundation-models:vjepa-policy" data-paper-title="V-JEPA Policy: Building Effective World-Action Models on Predictive Visual Latents" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="mechanism" data-domain="foundation-models" data-theme="multimodal-models" data-topic="multimodal-models/world-state-actions" data-search="V-JEPA Policy: Building Effective World-Action Models on Predictive Visual Latents 基础模型 Tsinghua University 2026-09-29 冻结 V-JEPA 2.1 视觉编码器，在预测视觉潜空间中联合训练 instruction-conditioned future-latent predictor 和 flow-matching action expert；动作生成读取 predictor 的未来信息上下文。 复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。执行 future-latent stop-gradient 与 action flow matching；未加载 V-JEPA 2.1 或机器人数据。执行 future-latent stop-gradient 与 action flow matching；未加载 V-JEPA 2.1 或机器人数据。本地对照口径：基线为论文机制关闭或默认状态，实验组为开启对应核心算子；本批只验证不变量和状态转换，跨模型相对变化不适用。  世界动作模型 预测视觉潜变量 机器人 多模态 视觉世界建模：状态、生成与动作条件 动作专家读取预测未来潜变量，与直接读取训练视频未来帧有何区别？ 预测未来由当前观察与指令生成，部署时也能获得；真实未来仅作为训练目标，用于塑造预测器。动作 flow expert 因而使用可计算的前瞻上下文，而非提前观察结果。冻结视觉编码器稳定表示，却不保证预测误差不会在控制过程中累积。 例如根据当前桌面预测抓取后的杯子位置，再产生动作；不能把实际抓取结束后的照片先传给策略再评价成功率。 2026-10-27">
<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/multimodal-models/world-state-actions/">多模态 / 视觉世界建模：状态、生成与动作条件</a></p>
<span id="paper-foundation-models-vjepa-policy-d720eedd" class="ar-learning-paper-anchor"></span>
<p class="ar-learning-level">核心机制</p>
<h2 id="qa-b1dc62a377da6fe6">动作专家读取预测未来潜变量，与直接读取训练视频未来帧有何区别？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=foundation-models%3Avjepa-policy">V-JEPA Policy: Building Effective World-Action Models on Predictive Visual Latents</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · Tsinghua University</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>预测未来由当前观察与指令生成，部署时也能获得；真实未来仅作为训练目标，用于塑造预测器。动作 flow expert 因而使用可计算的前瞻上下文，而非提前观察结果。冻结视觉编码器稳定表示，却不保证预测误差不会在控制过程中累积。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如根据当前桌面预测抓取后的杯子位置，再产生动作；不能把实际抓取结束后的照片先传给策略再评价成功率。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37250">原论文</a> · <a href="../../foundation-models/2609.37250-vjepa-policy/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-b1dc62a377da6fe6">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>
<article class="ar-learning-card ar-learning-qa" data-learning-card data-identity="foundation-models:vjepa-policy" data-paper-title="V-JEPA Policy: Building Effective World-Action Models on Predictive Visual Latents" data-learning-pending="false" data-level="implementation" data-domain="foundation-models" data-theme="multimodal-models" data-topic="multimodal-models/world-state-actions" data-search="V-JEPA Policy: Building Effective World-Action Models on Predictive Visual Latents 基础模型 Tsinghua University 2026-09-29 冻结 V-JEPA 2.1 视觉编码器，在预测视觉潜空间中联合训练 instruction-conditioned future-latent predictor 和 flow-matching action expert；动作生成读取 predictor 的未来信息上下文。 复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。复现级别：L1 核心机制诊断。执行 future-latent stop-gradient 与 action flow matching；未加载 V-JEPA 2.1 或机器人数据。执行 future-latent stop-gradient 与 action flow matching；未加载 V-JEPA 2.1 或机器人数据。本地对照口径：基线为论文机制关闭或默认状态，实验组为开启对应核心算子；本批只验证不变量和状态转换，跨模型相对变化不适用。  世界动作模型 预测视觉潜变量 机器人 多模态 视觉世界建模：状态、生成与动作条件 future target 的梯度隔离与本地实现边界应怎样表述？ 真实未来经冻结视觉编码器产生目标并 stop-gradient，masked 位置上做 L1，同时训练动作速度损失。本地只执行 future-latent 隔离和 flow 机制诊断，没有加载 V-JEPA 2.1 或机器人数据，不能将三 seed 小张量更新说成 LIBERO 策略已验证。 例如检查目标张量没有梯度可确认监督边界，但没有任何机器人 rollout，就不能计算实际动作成功率。 2026-10-27">
<p class="ar-learning-card__domain"><a href="../paths/multimodal-models/world-state-actions/">多模态 / 视觉世界建模：状态、生成与动作条件</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-level">实现细节</p>
<h2 id="qa-44f9ff0a4f6450b9">future target 的梯度隔离与本地实现边界应怎样表述？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=foundation-models%3Avjepa-policy">V-JEPA Policy: Building Effective World-Action Models on Predictive Visual Latents</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · Tsinghua University</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>真实未来经冻结视觉编码器产生目标并 stop-gradient，masked 位置上做 L1，同时训练动作速度损失。本地只执行 future-latent 隔离和 flow 机制诊断，没有加载 V-JEPA 2.1 或机器人数据，不能将三 seed 小张量更新说成 LIBERO 策略已验证。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如检查目标张量没有梯度可确认监督边界，但没有任何机器人 rollout，就不能计算实际动作成功率。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：核心公式、本地复现、复现边界；例子用于解释机制。</p>

</article>

<h2 id="qa-eae201df1d76d128">联合世界与动作训练与先训预测器再独立训动作头有什么区别？</h2>
<p class="ar-learning-paper"><a href="../all/?paper=foundation-models%3Avjepa-policy">V-JEPA Policy: Building Effective World-Action Models on Predictive Visual Latents</a></p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__meta">问答新增：2026-10-27 · Tsinghua University</p>
<details class="ar-learning-answer"><summary>展开答案与例子</summary>
<p><strong>答案：</strong>联合训练让未来预测与动作 flow 在同一训练框架中协调，动作专家使用 predictor 提供的未来信息；两阶段独立训练则可能让预测表征未适配控制需要。这里视觉 encoder 仍冻结，不能将联合 predictor/action 训练扩大为所有视觉参数都端到端更新。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-example"><strong>教学例子：</strong>例如动作头需要未来抓取位置，联合训练可协调预测上下文；但冻结 V-JEPA 编码器的权重依然不会因动作损失而变化。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-sources">依据：背景与主要改动、核心公式；例子用于解释机制。</p>
<p class="ar-learning-card__links"><a href="https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.37250">原论文</a> · <a href="../../foundation-models/2609.37250-vjepa-policy/">实现解读</a> · <a href="#qa-eae201df1d76d128">问题链接</a></p>
</details>
</article>
